title: How Phantom Debt & BNPL Are Destroying Lives in 2025
summary: Video compiles clips debating whether BNPL's untracked 'phantom debt' is a real systemic risk or an overblown concern.

assertions.quote: there is no hard measure of how many buy now pay later loans are out there

verdicts.note: CFPB states data about BNPL use, especially on multi-loan borrowers and total consumer debt, is limited because lenders don't typically report BNPL loans to credit reporting companies.

CFPB: because BNPL lenders generally haven't furnished loan data to credit bureaus and rely on soft-only inquiries, 'no lens into how much BNPL debt borrowers are carrying' exists even for other lenders -- the same invisibility that limits how precisely the market's total debt can be measured.

CFPB's market-monitoring data across five major lenders (Affirm, Afterpay, Klarna, PayPal, Zip) found 10.5% of borrowers were charged at least one late fee in 2021, up from 7.9% in 2020 -- far below the roughly 26-47% 'ever paid late' rates found in nationally representative or self-reported consumer surveys.
